svg.title: Their exact moment identities are P = 1{j=0} for 0 ≤j < m, by interpolation of tj at i<m witj+1 i zero. Therefore Dm,hf −hf′(0) starts in order hm+1, with its integral Taylor remainder. Apply this to the changed current pairing times the exponential action ratio on each active link, and average the color directions over the Haar adjoint orbit of a unit color basis vector. Sum over the finitely many active links. This is precisely Tm,h, including its current derivative and density derivative. Its bounds after division by h are (LCE2).
